content: I understand and agree to switch my billing to the {{organizationName}} wallet

comment.text: Checkbox label in a migration dialog used to confirm agreement to switch billing; includes the {{organizationName}} variable representing the target organization's name.

usage.context:
<ModalDialog.Footer>
 <div className={styles.footer}>
 <Checkbox
 isChecked={isAgreed}
 onChange={() => setIsAgreed((v) => !v)}
 label={t("MigrateAgree", { organizationName })}
 dataTestId="migrate_to_wallet_agree_checkbox"
 />
 <div className={styles.footerButtons}>
 <Button
 key="confirm"
